inspiration: Tiny single-purpose overlay icons: XP-drop and level icons are a few hundred bytes each, meant to read at a glance next to a number. Ref: plugin-playground/src/main/kotlin/XPDropPlugin/res/.
Data-driven item behaviour: the item table carries per-item flags so UI behaviour comes from a table, not code. Ref: structure of item_configs.json (values not reproduced).
Feature folders that ship their own res/: each small feature brings its own icons and config. Modular asset folder per feature. Ref: plugin-playground/src/main/kotlin/*/res/.
Camera feel: tweening on by default and mouse-wheel camera movement are listed as client changes. Interaction ideas worth recreating from scratch. Ref: README.md lines 42 and 52.
Crest at small size: one emblem drawn at 64 px as a faction marker; recreate with our own geometry and a legibility rule. Ref: client/src/main/resources/saradomin.png (not viewed).
Pixel label font: a small pixel-face font for overlay labels; make an original with our own proportions. Ref: plugin-playground/src/main/kotlin/KondoKit/res/runescape_small.ttf (header only).
